aiSettings.title: AI settings
aiSettings.description: Configure this site’s LLM API. The key stays on this site and is never shared with other organizations.
aiSettings.keyDescription: Key for an OpenAI-compatible API. Leave unset to use the platform default.
aiSettings.apiKeyHint: The key is never shown again. Saving with an empty field leaves the stored key unchanged.
aiSettings.apiKeyLeaveEmpty: Leave the field empty and save to keep the stored key.
aiSettings.sourceSite: Using this site’s own API key.
aiSettings.sourcePlatform: Using the platform default API key.
aiSettings.sourceNone: No API key configured; features that need a model will use the rule-based fallback.
aiSettings.clearDescription: This deletes the key stored for this site. Afterwards the platform default is used (if that is also empty, features that need a model will use the rule-based fallback).
aiSettings.cleared: Now using the platform default key
aiSettings.modelDescription: Model name and temperature used for calls. Leave blank to inherit the platform default.
aiSettings.modelHint: For example gpt-4o or deepseek-v4-flash. Leave blank to inherit the platform default.
aiSettings.temperatureHint: 0 to 2. Leave blank to inherit the default 0.2.

tenants.description: Create, suspend, or restore SaaS tenant organizations
tenants.createHint: Click New tenant in the top right
tenants.name: Name
tenants.customDomainDescription: When set, visits via this hostname are locked to this tenant (marketing + app). Point DNS at this instance, then issue a certificate below. Leave empty to clear.

edit.title: Edit tenant — {{slug}}
edit.defaultSlugLocked: Default tenant slug cannot be changed

features.title: Modules & feature toggles
features.description: {{name}} · Control tenant capabilities by module; disabling a module disables its features

plan.title: Plan management
plan.endsAtHint: Leave empty for no expiry. Changing plan applies the matching feature and quota templates

resetPassword.title: Reset admin password — {{name}}
resetPassword.passwordHint: At least 6 characters; leave empty to auto-generate. If the admin account was deleted, it will be recreated.
resetPassword.passwordMinLength: Password must be at least 6 characters

adminCredentials.title: Tenant admin credentials
adminCredentials.hint: Save these credentials now — the plain password cannot be viewed again after closing.
adminCredentials.recreatedHint: The previous admin account did not exist and was recreated. Save these credentials — the plain password cannot be viewed again.

impersonate.title: Impersonate tenant
impersonate.description: Enter {{name}} as the selected user for troubleshooting. Session expires in about 4 hours.
impersonate.sessionExpired: Platform session expired — please sign in again

actions.archiveDescription: Archive tenant "{{name}}"? Users cannot sign in; data remains in the database.
actions.suspendDescription: Suspend tenant "{{name}}"? Users cannot sign in or call APIs.

admins.description: Manage platform admin accounts and roles
admins.deleteDescription: Delete admin {{username}}? This cannot be undone.

sheet.createDescription: Create a new platform admin account
sheet.passwordMinLength: Password must be at least 6 characters

admins.emptyHint: Add an admin to grant access to the platform console.

dashboard.description: Cross-tenant slow query overview to find performance bottlenecks
dashboard.routeTop10: Top 10 routes by slow query count
dashboard.fingerprintTop10: Top 10 SQL fingerprints by max duration

planLimitTemplates.title: Plan limit templates
planLimitTemplates.description: Default usage limits per plan. Changes apply to new tenants and future plan changes only — existing tenant overrides are not changed
planLimitTemplates.ultimateHint: Ultimate is for internal tenants; all limits are unlimited by default.

settings.description: Platform-wide settings including self-registration, tenant approval, and plan limit templates

registration.title: Self-registration
registration.description: Control whether new users can register on their own
registration.hint: When disabled, users cannot self-register; platform admins must create accounts. Consider disabling during testing.
registration.hintSingleTenant: When enabled, new users join the default tenant (no new organization is created).
registration.confirmDisableDescription: New users will not be able to register. They must contact a platform admin. Continue?

tenantApproval.title: Tenant approval
tenantApproval.description: Control whether newly registered tenants require platform admin approval
tenantApproval.hint: When enabled, new tenants need approval before full access. Recommended for production.

captcha.title: Captcha
captcha.description: Control captcha on login and registration
captcha.hint: When enabled, users must complete a slider captcha on login and registration. Recommended for public deployments.

defaultTheme.title: Default theme
defaultTheme.description: Default palette for tenants. Tenants can override under Tenant → Appearance; users can switch in the sidebar

defaultLayout.title: Default layout
defaultLayout.description: Default shell layout for tenants. Applies on tablet/desktop (≥768px); mobile always uses top bar + bottom nav

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.description: Custom for large customers — contact sales

ultimate.name: Ultimate
ultimate.description: Internal tenants with no usage limits

max_users.label: Max users
max_users.description: Login users in the tenant (excluding impersonation shadow accounts)

plansConfig.description: One tab per plan, everything in one place: pricing and copy feed the public pricing section, quotas are written to the organization when the plan is granted. Empty copy falls back to the built-in defaults.
plansConfig.priceHint: Leave empty for custom pricing — the section shows “Contact us”
plansConfig.priceInvalid: Price must be a number, zero or greater
plansConfig.publicListed: Show in the public pricing section
plansConfig.name: Plan name
plansConfig.featuresHint: One per line; leave empty to use the built-in copy
plansConfig.sectionCopyHint: Leave empty to use the built-in copy; the pricing section picks the visitor's language.
plansConfig.sectionLimitsHint: Written to the organization when this plan is granted; empty means unlimited.

backup.description: Whole-database PostgreSQL backup and restore, covering every tenant's data

backup.label: Create a backup
backup.hint: Exports a full database dump. Runs in the background; download it from the task center when it finishes
backup.started: Backup started — track it in the task center

restore.label: Restore from a backup
restore.hint: Overwrites the current database with a backup file. Make sure you have a usable backup first
restore.title: Restore database from a backup
restore.description: Pick a backup already on the server, or upload a dump file
restore.warningDescription: Restoring drops the current public schema before importing the backup. Every tenant will be unavailable while it runs, and existing data will not be kept.
restore.noLocalFiles: No dump files found in the backup directories. Check DATABASE_RESTORE_LOCAL_PATHS, or upload a file instead.
restore.chooseFileFirst: Choose the backup file to upload first
restore.wrongFormat: Only pg_dump custom-format (.dump) files are supported
restore.confirmDescription: This overwrites the current database with "{{filename}}". Existing data will not be kept and this cannot be undone.
restore.started: Restore started — track it in the task center
